blocks.instructionalPurpose: Sustained reading with words explained in context. Learner action: Identify the evidence and the change in the fictional reflection.

accessibility.textAlternative: An illustrative reflection. I first added when the score instruction said set. I checked my trace against the instruction. Set replaced the previous score, so I revised that step. It reminded me to match each site claim to the right observation in Social Studies. Tomorrow I want to test another event order.

blocks.instructionalPurpose: Choose an answer and get feedback written for that choice. Learner action: Choose the evidence-based interpretation and explain it.

responseSignals.feedback: Confidence does not identify what the trace showed.
Feeling certain cannot replace checking the instruction.

accessibility.textAlternative: What supports the pupil's revision? Options: Greater confidence is enough to establish the answer without checking.; The set instruction and the trace show which step needed changing.; Feeling certain proves the original step was right..

responseSignals.feedback: Hiding evidence prevents an honest explanation of the revision.
The conflicting result is useful evidence; explain it rather than removing it.

accessibility.textAlternative: What should a learner do with a valid result that challenges an idea? Options: Hide it so the original idea still appears correct.; Remove the conflicting result before sharing the reflection.; Keep it and explain what it changes or leaves uncertain..
